slides.title: riskdep: a crisis on a mainnet fork
slides.subtitle: Belem RWA EURCV vault · 2-minute demo · scripts/fork/demo.sh --short
slides.notes: Sources: scripts/fork/DEMO-EXPLAINED.md, docs/analysis/FORK-PRESENTATION.md, plan/2026-10-11-fork-demo.plan.md; run measured 2026-10-11 (112 s).

slides.title: Why a mainnet fork
bullets: A local copy of Ethereum at block 26,165,572 (anvil)
Real vault, real positions, real oracles and roles
The crisis is caused by roles the protocols grant
Issuer's feed admin, Midas timelock, a liquidator
No exploit; nothing reaches the real network
riskdep watches the vault live, block by block
slides.notes: A recorded mainnet range shows what happened; a fork shows what the tool does in a crisis. anvil --auto-impersonate lets the script send transactions from any address.

slides.title: The vault: three fragilities
bullets: Belem RWA EURCV: 4.71M EURCV, curated by RockawayX
86 % lent in one market, against mGLOeuro (LLTV 77 %)
One EOA writes the mGLOeuro price (NAV)
Fixed band 90,000 - 110,000 EUR; below needs new code
New code passes a 48 h timelock
One borrower holds all 3.68M EURCV of debt, LTV 0.70
slides.notes: mGLOeuro: Midas token for a Fasanara private-credit fund, ~100,000 EUR per token. The feed admin is 0xa301…600c, the only holder of feedAdminRole. Borrower 0xa122…E7c6 posted 52.58 mGLOeuro.

slides.title: What each mGLOeuro price means
table: Lowest price the feed accepts today
Below this, liquidation leaves bad debt
251,761 EURCV of bad debt for the vault
slides.notes: Liquidatable: 100,000 x 0.70 / 0.77. Bad debt: debt x LIF / collateral, LIF = 1 / (0.3 x 0.77 + 0.7) = 1.074, i.e. a 7.4 % liquidation bonus.

slides.title: Prediction, before the crisis
slides.notes: riskdep analyze --vault ... --shock token=mGLOeuro:0.10 / 0.30, offline from fixtures/replay/incident-0xd6d4…. Why STAY at -30 %: the depositor holds 99.5 % of the vault, and only ~8 % can be withdrawn at 91 % utilisation, so the loss falls on it whatever it does.

slides.title: What riskdep finds at start-up
bullets: Feed band: mGLOeuro cannot fall below 90,000 without an upgrade
A larger loss stays invisible to the market until then
Timelock: the upgrade must pass Midas's 48 h timelock
riskdep watches its queue
Exit gates abdicated: the curator can never lock withdrawals
slides.notes: Alerts FeedBand (warn), AdminSurface timelock (info), ExitGate (info). Found from the vault address alone: vault -> market -> oracle -> feed -> proxy admin -> timelock.

slides.title: The crisis, act by act
bullets: Issuer sets the NAV to 90,000: one transaction, no delay
Real loss is 30 %: Midas schedules a feed upgrade
48 hours later (fork clock moved): upgrade executed, NAV 70,000
A liquidator seizes the rest: bad debt written off
slides.notes: Act 2: setRoundData(9e12) from the feed-admin EOA. Act 6: schedule on MidasTimelockController by its proposer Safe, evm_increaseTime 48 h, execute, setRoundData(7e12). MGloEuroFeedV2 is a demo implementation, not Midas code. Act 7: liquidate the remaining collateral.

slides.title: What riskdep says, and when
table: Executable in 48 h: the window to act
slides.notes: Totals for the short run: 5 critical, 13 warn. The key alert is the scheduled upgrade: without watching the timelock queue, the first sign would be the upgrade itself, 48 h too late.

slides.title: Predicted against observed
slides.notes: Gap 0.5 %: the interest the debt accrued during the 48 h time jump. The prediction ran before anything happened, on a recording of the vault.
slides.text:
Predicted before the crisis:   251,761 EURCV
Observed on the fork:           252,914 EURCV

Gap 0.5 %: interest accrued during the 48 h jump

slides.title: What the demo proves
left: Discovery: feed, its admin, band, timelock
Real data: mainnet state at a real block
slides.notes: Judging weights: discovery 30 %, impact 30 %, decision 25 %, demo on real data 15 %. Alternative crises scripted: alt-redstone.sh, alt-pst-mint.sh, alt-fxsave-expiry.sh.

slides.title: Run it
slides.text:
scripts/fork/demo.sh --short      (about 2 minutes)
scripts/fork/demo.sh --record     (asciinema video)
scripts/fork/demo.sh --stop       (stop everything)

Offline, no fork:
riskdep watch --vault 0xD6d4… --replay --record-as fork-belem
slides.notes: Needs Foundry (anvil, cast, forge) and uv; no API key. Explanation of every output line: scripts/fork/DEMO-EXPLAINED.md.
